info:
Portuguese conjunctions are nearly identical to Spanish but have some unique flavors.

Coordinating Conjunctions:

e (and): Eu gosto de música e dança.
(I like music and dance.)
mas (but): Quero ir, mas não posso.
(I want to go, but I can’t.)
Subordinating Conjunctions:

porque (because): Estou feliz porque estou com amigos.
(I’m happy because I’m with friends.)
Tip:
Portuguese has a causal conjunction pois ("for/because"), which adds elegance: Não saímos, pois estava tarde. (We didn’t leave because it was late.)
